Engineer Dies After Falling Into Open Drain in Noida

An engineer tragically died after falling into an open drain in Noida, with CCTV footage capturing his final moments. His family has attributed his death to alleged negligence by the Noida Authority. The incident occurred amidst heavy rainfall, and an electrocution angle is also being investigated.
